# American Drywall and Plaster, LLC

> Family-owned drywall, plaster, texture, repair, and painting contractor based in Urbandale, Iowa, serving the Greater Des Moines metro for residential and commercial clients.

- Location: Urbandale, IA 50323
- Phone / text: (515) 249-7306
- Email: aldin.subasic@icloud.com
- Owner: Aldin Subasic (works alongside his father on jobs)

## Services
- Drywall installation, finishing, texturing, repair, water-damage restoration, basement finishing, popcorn ceiling removal
- Plaster repair, skim coating, veneer plaster, smooth and textured finishes, historic restoration
- Stucco installation and repair, EIFS repair, crack repair, re-coating, moisture remediation
- Interior painting (walls, ceilings, trim, cabinets, accent walls, prep, primer)
- Exterior painting (full exteriors, stucco/siding paint, deck staining, power washing)
- LVP flooring installation

## Service Area
Urbandale, Johnston, Clive, Waukee, West Des Moines, Des Moines, Grimes, Ankeny, Windsor Heights, and the wider Polk and Dallas County areas.
